Sinusoidal

A card roguelike in a dark forest. A mechanical creature sits across the clearing. Open its skull and cut the wires that steer its language-model brain.

Default combat: two heroes with 30 health, mana growing to ten, seven minions per side, targeted attacks and spells. The pool contains 53 collectible cards and five tokens.

Controls and verification
  • Click a hand card to play it; targeted effects wait for a target. Select a ready minion, then its target to attack. Taunt must be attacked first. Turn the hourglass to end your turn.
  • Hold the right mouse button and drag to look around. Space returns to the board or map. Open head reveals the four wires.
  • Settings → Old lane rules starts a fresh run using the original combat.
  • The render is 1440 × 810. Screenshots use seed 7, a fixed demo board and no brain server. Creature close-ups use the same opening animation as play.
  • Rules, combat controls, creature heads and persona gauges were checked. Complete scene-driven runs were checked in both combat modes.
Generated models still have rough side textures; their 256 px maps are now sampled smoothly. Presentation remains in development. This page is private; the public snapshot stays private pending the writing workflow.
